Kaisiṭṭha(kṛtasiddha)
a name of Vṛttajātisamuccaya of Virahāṅka.

Kaiśavī
name of C. by Ramaprasanna Sastri on Vāsudevavijaya of Vāsudeva, Puruvanam.
Pt.. Lahore, 1915. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1179.

Kaiśikadvādaśīmāhātmya
assigned to the Varāhapurāṇa. Mysore I. p. 182 (2 mss.).

Kaiśikapurāṇa
or kai. mAhAtmya or kai. upAkhyAna on the legend of a Caṇḍāla devotee-singer named Nambāḍuvān, his trials an. deliverance by the Lord. Assigned to Bhūmi-Varāha-saṁvāda in Varāhapurāṇa.
Adyar I. p. 143a (5 mss.). Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 20 (4 mss.).
(66th ch. with Tamil meaning). 2395 (ch. 48). 2396 (inc. with Kannada C.). 2397. 17552.
(a.. 4679 (e) (with Tamil meaning). 6178 (inc.). (with Tamil meaning). Mysore I. p.. 163. 182. Oppert

B (last five with Tamil meaning; all inc.).
--C. by Kṛṣṇapāda. Mysore I. p. 465.
The great Parāśara Bhaṭṭa wrote C. in mixed Tamil-Skt. style.
